A Geneva in-office IC role is hard to find — worth the conversation.

The security-sensitive, high-reliability environment maps to the kind of architectural responsibility Magino held at Alaya and Benevity.

top_offers.why: Frontify's Backend Platform team builds the internal foundations other product teams rely on — API design, scalability, reliability — which aligns with Magino's platform ownership mindset.
